description: This is a shell script that checks the authentication status for Claude Code and OpenClaw services, including credential validation, expiration checks, and status reporting in different formats.

methods.name: fetch_models_status_json
methods.description: Fetches the status JSON from the openclaw command, returning an empty string if it fails.

methods.name: calc_status_from_expires
methods.description: Calculates status string based on expiration timestamp.

methods.name: json_expires_for_claude_cli
methods.description: Extracts the maximum expiration timestamp for Claude credentials from JSON status.

methods.name: json_expires_for_anthropic_any
methods.description: Extracts the maximum expiration timestamp for any anthropic profile from JSON status.

methods.name: json_best_anthropic_profile
methods.description: Selects the profile ID with the latest expiration for anthropic profiles.

methods.name: json_anthropic_api_key_count
methods.description: Counts the number of API keys for the anthropic provider in JSON status.

methods.name: check_claude_code_auth
methods.description: Checks the status of Claude Code authentication, based on JSON or file credentials.

methods.name: check_openclaw_auth
methods.description: Checks the status of OpenClaw authorization, based on JSON or file credentials.
